questions.subject: PHYSICS_EM
questions.learningObjective: Explain why EM needs no medium
questions.stem: Why can electromagnetic waves travel through vacuum?

answer.exemplar: Oscillating electric and magnetic fields regenerate each other per Maxwell's equations, so no material medium is needed for propagation.

questions.explanation: Field self-regeneration sustains the wave. Mechanical waves need matter; EM does not.
